## Key entry points

- {{< rust-src masreml lib.rs >}} — extendr export macros
- {{< rust-src masreml reml/mod.rs >}} — REML solver dispatch (HE, EM, AI, HI, adaptive)
- {{< rust-src masreml reml/ai_reml.rs >}} — Average-Information REML iteration
- {{< rust-src masreml reml/em_reml.rs >}} — Expectation-Maximisation REML iteration
- {{< rust-src masreml reml/he_regression.rs >}} — Haseman-Elston regression
- {{< rust-src masreml solver/mod.rs >}} — MME solver dispatch (Cholesky, PCG)
- {{< rust-src masreml matrix/mod.rs >}} — relationship-matrix builders (G_snp, G_mh, A_ped, D_snp)
- {{< rust-src masreml gwas/mod.rs >}} — GWAS implementation (EMMAX + smoothing)
